about: The coordinator's review of the 2026-09-25 hook-research wave (the 26 organisations behind the named leads added after the first wave). 'hooks': decisions on proposed hooks. 'checks': points the research agents raised for a person to check before any message; each becomes a review item in the master. Location hooks are kept only when they name a specific place, the weakest basis the hook guidance allows; 'in Arusha' alone gives the reader no reason, since every lead is in the Arusha area. Sources: the agents' records and coverage logs in this folder.
